neighbours.label: plain assertion that sets the rest aside: 'All I know is …', 'I just know …', 'They just do'
fire: All I know is that we won the match on Sunday.
He says it is lucky. I don't know. I just know I like it.
Fame? I just wanted to sing with my friends.
Nobody can say why cats do that. They just do.
All I know is I'd rather stay home tonight.
Is it fate? I can't say. I just know we belong here.
Records? I just wanted to run faster than my brother.
Kids don't explain why they love it. They just do.
quiet: We know that we won the match on Sunday.
He says it is lucky. He bought it in a small shop.
She wanted to sing with her friends.
Nobody can say why the bus was late on Friday.
I would rather stay home tonight with the dog.
Is it far? I can drive there in an hour.
He wanted to run with his brother at the park.
Kids love to play outside when the weather is nice.
